displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">Catalog</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.libraries} libraries</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color="violet">Glance</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Grid gutter="xs">
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="violet">Movies</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.movies}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="blue">Shows</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.shows}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="teal">Episodes</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.episodes}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="orange">This week</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.addedWeek}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
